## Summary

Explain what changed, why it changed, and link related issues.

## Validation

List the exact commands run and their results. Explain anything not run.

## Compatibility and safety

- [ ] Tests were added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when user-facing behavior changed.
- [ ] JSON, report, and configuration compatibility were considered.
- [ ] `docs/SCORING.md` was updated if checks, severities, or deductions changed.
- [ ] Scanner behavior remains deterministic and local-only.
- [ ] No `.env` contents, credentials, tokens, private keys, or other secrets are included.
- [ ] Commits use conventional commit messages.
